Sub Binder / Day Bundle Generator

Pulls together everything the toolkit already knows for a given day — standing details, emergency info, the calendar, seating, hall pass procedure, behavior plan, and exit ticket bank — into one printable packet, so a substitute gets one stack instead of six separate tools.

More detail

The packet above is a quick summary. For the full official sub plan document (with Word export) or the building’s room-by-room schedule, use these:

Sub Plan Builder → Schedule Browser →

Shared sections (standing details, seating, hall pass, behavior plan) print once; the calendar entry and lesson print once per day, with a divider header for each.

Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded. Reads standing details and plan history from Sub Plan Builder, the calendar entry from School Calendar Visualizer, the chart from Seating Chart Generator, and (when saved) the hall pass procedure, behavior plan, and exit ticket bank from their own tools. The date above defaults to whatever you last selected in Sub Plan Builder; edit any source elsewhere, then click “Refresh data” here (or just reload) to pull in the latest.
